Application Data.NAME: Dough Delight Bakery
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Sweet Treats Lane, Suite 200, Anytown, NY 12345-6789
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Dough Delight Bakery specializes in crafting a wide variety of artisanal breads, pastries, and bagels made with high-quality ingredients. Our operations include baking fresh goods daily, providing custom cake orders for special occasions, and serving a selection of coffee and tea beverages. We create a welcoming environment for customers to enjoy their purchases on-site, with limited seating available. Additionally, we host occasional baking classes and community events to engage with local residents and promote our products. Our commitment to food safety and quality assurance is paramount, ensuring that all health regulations are strictly adhered to during our operations.
